onboarding.1-mo-ta: A small pagoda corner on your phone, a place to pause for a few minutes each day.
onboarding.2-tieu-de: Light incense, ring the bell, tap the wooden fish
onboarding.2-mo-ta: Each gesture is a slow breath that helps the mind settle.
onboarding.3-mo-ta: The verses here are for reflection, not predictions.
onboarding.4-tieu-de: Hang a wish on the Wishing Tree
onboarding.4-mo-ta: Write what you hope for, anonymously if you like, and read the wishes of others.
thap-huong.huong-dan: Tap and hold to light a stick of incense.
thap-huong.dang-chay: The incense is burning. Breathe slowly with the smoke.
thap-huong.da-tan: The incense has burned down. Thank you for taking this time.
thap-huong.so-nen: You have lit {n} incense sticks today.
thap-huong.goi-y: One stick is enough. What matters is a sincere heart.
chuong-mo.huong-dan: Tap gently to ring the bell, and listen until the sound fades.
chuong-mo.nhip-tho: Breathe in with one bell, breathe out with the next.
xin-que.huong-dan: Think about what is on your mind, then gently shake the verse cup.
xin-que.chon-chu-de: What would you like to reflect on?
xin-que.ghi-chu: This verse is for reflection. Every choice is still yours.
xin-que.goi-y-moi-ngay: One verse a day is plenty, so there is time to reflect on it.
xin-que.da-xin-hom-nay: You have already drawn a verse today. Why not read it once more?
cay-nguyen.mo-ta: Wishes hang here, anonymous and kind.
cay-nguyen.goi-y-viet: What do you hope for, for yourself or someone you love?
cay-nguyen.qua-dai: Your wish is over 120 characters. Please shorten it a little.
cay-nguyen.da-treo: Your wish is now hanging on the Wishing Tree.
cay-nguyen.cong-khai: Anyone may read your wish. Please do not include personal information.
kiem-duyet.muc-do-1: A few words that did not fit were covered. Please review before hanging.
kiem-duyet.muc-do-2: This wish cannot be hung yet. Please try rewording it more gently.
kiem-duyet.muc-do-3: This wish cannot be hung yet. Please try rewording it more gently. The content has been noted for review.
kiem-duyet.biet-danh: This nickname does not fit here. Please choose another.
kiem-duyet.han-che: This device cannot hang wishes for now. Thank you for understanding.
bao-cao.cam-on: Thank you. We will review this report.
chan.xac-nhan: You will no longer see wishes from this writer. Continue?
chan.da-chan: Hidden. You can unblock in Settings.
cai-dat.biet-danh-mo-ta: Optional. If left blank, your wishes appear as "Someone".
cai-dat.ma-thiet-bi-mo-ta: An anonymous code created by the app. Use it when contacting support.
cai-dat.xoa-du-lieu-mo-ta: Deletes your nickname, wishes and history from our servers and this device.
cai-dat.xoa-buoc-1: Are you sure you want to delete all your data?
cai-dat.xoa-buoc-2: This cannot be undone. Your wishes will be removed from the Wishing Tree.
cai-dat.thong-bao-mo-ta: Gentle reminders for the daily message and lunar holidays.
trang-thai-rong.cay-nguyen: The Wishing Tree is still bare. Would you like to hang the first wish?
trang-thai-rong.loi-nguyen-cua-toi: You have not hung any wishes yet.
trang-thai-rong.lich-su-que: You have not drawn a verse yet. When you are ready, give it a try.
loi.mang: No internet connection. Please check and try again.
loi.chung: Something went wrong. Please try again in a few minutes.
loi.gui-that-bai: Could not send. Your wish has been kept so you can send it again.
lich-am.ghi-chu: Lunar dates are calculated in Vietnam time.
mua.ram-thang-gieng: First Full Moon of the Lunar Year
mua.trang-tri-moi: The courtyard has been decorated for the new season.
